Application Data.NAME: Evergreen Memorial Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Evergreen Memorial Services specializes in providing compassionate funeral services and memorialization, including traditional burial and cremation options. Our operations encompass arranging and conducting memorial ceremonies, offering grief support resources, and creating personalized tribute materials. We also provide engraving services for headstones and urns while ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements. Our facility is equipped to handle all aspects of funeral service delivery, including embalming and professional care of remains. We prioritize the emotional and financial sensitivity of our clients, ensuring a respectful and dignified service experience.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 09/15/2022, a loss occurred due to a fire in the embalming room caused by a malfunctioning heating unit, resulting in damages amounting to $10,000. The fire was contained, and no injuries were reported. The claim was filed with the insurance carrier and is currently closed. Additionally, on 01/20/2023, a minor water leak damaged some memorial supplies leading to $5,000 in repairs. This issue has been resolved, and no further claims are pending.
